name: What are the benefits of installing under cabinet lighting?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of installing under cabinet lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under cabinet lighting offers numerous practical and aesthetic benefits. It significantly improves task lighting on countertops, making food preparation and other activities easier and safer. It also eliminates shadows cast by overhead lighting, creating a more inviting and well-lit workspace. Aesthetically, it enhances the ambiance of your kitchen or other spaces, highlighting backsplashes and adding a sophisticated, modern touch. Energy-efficient LED options also contribute to lower electricity bills.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include improved task lighting, elimination of shadows, enhanced kitchen ambiance, and increased home value.
